shadowSentences: It is a sunny day today.
I enjoy reading books in my free time.
Traveling to new places brings me joy.
Cooking dinner can be a fun activity.
Listening to music helps me relax after work.
Walking in nature is refreshing and peaceful.
I like to try new recipes during the weekends.
Attending local events can be a great way to meet people.
Gardening is a rewarding hobby that takes patience.
Volunteering in my community gives me a sense of purpose.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your favorite travel experience?
Q2: What are some challenges you face when planning a trip?
Q3: How important do you think travel is for personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you encountered any obstacles in maintaining a fitness routine?
Q3: In your opinion, how does exercise impact mental health?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone starting an exercise program?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite healthy meal to cook?
Q2: What difficulties do you face when trying to eat healthy?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of nutrition in daily life?
Q4: What recommendations would you give for maintaining a balanced diet?
